dynamic_line: Unsurprisingly, the consumer-grade weather station malfunctioned during the storm recording.  Nevertheless, you've proved yourself a capable contractor.  Therefore, we'd like you to retrieve more advanced recording equipment.  Some time ago we lost contact with a DARPA-affiliated limnological test station, and we have reason to believe they kept sensitive recording equipment on hand.  We'd like you to retrieve it - for your standard contracting fee, of course.

responses.text: Alright, I'll find the advanced weather recording equipment.
What does the equipment look like?
Based on our previous work together, I'm guessing there may be some resistance?
What else do you have available?
